full_judgment: ii) Sonabuddin Saial had been the owner of 1.45 acres of land recorded in State Acquisition Khatian No. 81. On the death of Sonabuddin Saial, his son Hossain Ali Saial and daughter Tufani Bibi along with other heir son and daughter inherited land left by Sonabuddin saial. Pre-emptor First opposite party because co-sharer by purchase over 17-1/2 + 3-1/2 in all 21 acreas of land on the strength of two deeds of conveyance dated 31.7.1991 and 17.12.1991 respectively from heir son Hossain Ali Saial and daughter Tufani Bibi of Sonabuddin Saial.
